verdict.rationale: LightSprint says its onboarding agent automatically sets up the codebase, environment variables and setup script [docs-10]. It also says each task gets an isolated full-stack sandbox, with a branched database when needed, and needs no local setup [docs-14, docs-5]. Repositories are connected directly [docs-34]. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that dependencies are installed (only implied by the 'setup script'), in-depth docs on how the onboarding agent configures environments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
